title: Oily Nutty Norwegian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty Norwegian lamb stew with a rich nutty flavor and a hint of Massaman curry paste, perfect for a cold winter's night. This dish is meal-prep friendly and features ingredients that align with Ayurvedic tamasic principles.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the Massaman curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, sliced almonds, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 1.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
